title: Disk Manager & Buffer Manager
description: Implement page-level disk I/O and a buffer pool with LRU replacement policy. You will build the foundation that all upper layers depend on.

title: Object Manager (Slotted Page)
description: Implement a slotted page structure for variable-length record storage. You will handle record insertion, deletion, and serialization/deserialization.

title: B+-Tree Index
description: Implement a disk-based B+-Tree index supporting search, insertion with leaf/internal node splitting, and range scan via sibling pointers.

title: Query Parser & Planner
description: Extend the SQL parser to handle GROUP BY, ORDER BY, and aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX). Build corresponding logical plan nodes.

title: Query Executor
description: Implement Sort, Aggregate, and Index Scan operators following the Volcano iterator model (Open/Next/Close). These operators complete the query execution pipeline.

title: ARIES Recovery
description: Implement a Write-Ahead Log (WAL) and the full ARIES recovery algorithm with Analysis, Redo, and Undo phases. Supports transactions, checkpoints, and crash recovery with compensation log records (CLR).

title: Vector Similarity Search (DiskANN)
description: Implement a DiskANN graph-based index for approximate nearest neighbor search. Extends the DBMS with vector data type, L2 distance, Vamana graph construction, and greedy beam search — touching storage, index, and query layers.
